name: Kisses & Curses
source:
Start your journey as a young Witch in the peaceful but uneventful town of Werbury. As the Stargazer, it is your role to absorb infrequent bursts of Wild Magic known as Starfall.

Despite your magical heritage your life is pretty ordinary… until an increase of Starfalls known as Starfloods start to plague the world. You are approached by a mysterious member of the Witch Council who says that only a ritual involves you, a human and another Witch can calm the source of Starfalls.

Who will you choose to accompany you on your journey? What path of Witchcraft will you tread in your quest to save the world?

[from [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/story/]official website[/url]]
translation:
在宁静而平静的韦伯里小镇开始你作为年轻女巫的旅程。作为观星者，你的职责是吸收罕见的狂野魔法爆发，即星落。

尽管你拥有魔法遗产，但你的生活却相当平凡……直到被称为“星洪”的星落增加开始困扰世界。女巫委员会的一位神秘成员找到你，她说只有你、一个人类和另一个女巫参与的仪式才能平息星落的源头。

你会选择谁陪伴你的旅程？在拯救世界的过程中，你会走哪条巫术之路？

【来自[url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/story/]官网[/url]】
